name: Fiachna of Munster
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Fiachna of Munster is listed in the encyclopedia index at page 185. The page also indexes the F-headings that follow, among them Fiachra (pages 87-88 and 185), Fial (185), Fianna (185-186 and 192), Fideal (186), Fiecal (186), Figgy Dowdy (186-187), Find (187), Findchóem (187), Findias (187), Finn (188), and Finn McCool (pages 44, 190, 213, 295). The same index entry notes that the Fionn Cycle is also called the Fenian Cycle.

okr.objective: Fiachna of Munster is a figure indexed at page 185, grouped with the following F-headings.
key_results: Grouped with Fiachra, Fial, Fianna, Fideal, Fiecal, Figgy Dowdy, Find, Findchóem, Findias, Finn, and Finn McCool.
The Fionn Cycle is cross-referenced to the Fenian Cycle.
